title: 替换标题
narration_text: 在这里写入经过审核的完整生产旁白。

protagonist.description: 按故事确定；本篇所有画面保持身份、外形标志、服装和配色一致
protagonist.selection_rationale: 说明为什么这个角色设定适合本篇；性别两者都成立时优先女性，明显更适合男性时使用男性，不按原文代词机械决定。

appearance.hair: 根据人物与故事选择的发型，并核对最近作品避免连续重复
appearance.silhouette: 体态、服装外轮廓和标志物

visual_brief.fable_law: 本篇超现实规则，例如：一被看见身体就会透明。
symbolic_objects: 一个最能承载寓言规则的物件
visual_brief.art_style_logic: 说明本篇为什么适合选定的艺术语言；风格服务故事，不做抽象艺术短片。

character_pack.turnaround_prompt: vertical 9:16 single 2x2 character turnaround sheet, four equal clean panels showing one consistent reviewed protagonist exactly once in each panel: front view, left three-quarter view, right profile view, back three-quarter view, identical face hair clothing palette and signature object in every panel, full body, stable anatomy, plain warm studio background, clear panel separation through natural background spacing

semantic_beats.script_anchor: 在这里填写该事件在 narration_text 中按顺序出现的唯一短句
semantic_beats.story_event: 主角在一个可信的日常空间里遇到本篇寓言事件。
semantic_beats.fable_law: 超现实规则第一次以真实事件显现。
semantic_beats.art_style_logic: 电影绘本和克制魔法现实让事件既可信又有寓言感。
semantic_beats.prompt: vertical 9:16 cinematic storybook illustration, replace with reviewed scene prompt, clear story event in an ordinary place, the fable law appears as a real physical change, tactile paper texture, restrained magical realism, stable protagonist identity

cover_prompt: vertical 9:16 human-free symbolic artwork, one story-derived object or environment detail expresses the central metaphor, refined material texture, a calm naturally open upper field made of sky mist or paper grain, balanced symbolic composition

hero_wan.prompt: one restrained physically coherent action, stable identity and structure, calm camera drift
